rationale: The agent initiated returns on two orders without first explicitly authenticating the user and without obtaining confirmation prior to performing order-changing actions, both of which violate the stated policy. While the returns appear to have been processed to the original payment methods and for the correct user’s orders, the lack of confirmation before the write and absence of clear authentication steps mean the interaction does not meet the pass bar. The final message also did not provide clear post-action details, though that alone wouldn’t fail the case; the primary issues are the missing authentication and confirmation.
